name: V Rising
hint: Vampire survival server, joined from the in-game server list through the game's relay

SERVER_NAME.title: Server name
SERVER_NAME.description: Players find the server by this name in the in-game server list and join from there. The server is listed with its IP hidden, so players connect through the game's relay servers; direct connect by IP does not work.

SERVER_PASSWORD.title: Server password
SERVER_PASSWORD.description: Leave empty for an open server. The server is listed publicly so players can find it.
